description: This file defines a React component 'SidebarLayout' for a web application's layout, including navigation sidebar, header, and user authentication handling. It contains UI elements like navigation links, user info, and logout functionality, and manages authentication state using custom auth functions.

methods.name: updateAuth
methods.description: Updates authentication information for tenantId or companyId and updates component state accordingly.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Clears authentication data and redirects to home page.
